githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 9 adds Discord's Favorites server, scheduled messages, @silent messages, pinned channels and a message font size setting. It also makes your theme colour SakuraCord's real macOS accent, keeps coloured mentions readable on any background, and rebuilds the forum post composer and game profiles.

## Favorites

- Added Discord's Favorites server: a star tile under Home that collects favourite channels, threads, forum posts and DMs from any server, synced both ways with Discord.
- Added favourites categories you can create, rename, collapse, delete and mark as read, plus nicknames and Move To for each favourite.
- Added Suggested Channels and an Add to Favorites picker, ordered the way Discord orders them, with Discord's empty state when you have no favourites yet.
- Added Thread Settings, which can file threads you join into Favorites automatically and remove them once read, along with Hide Favorites and Reset Favorites.
- Added a way past the three-favourite limit without Nitro: the limit notice can turn on Unlimited Favorites, which keeps extra favourites on this Mac.

## Messages and composer

- Added scheduled messages. Schedule Message in the + menu offers Discord's shortcuts and a custom time, and Inbox › Scheduled lets you edit, reschedule, send now or cancel, synced with Discord.
- Added @silent messages: a message starting with @silent is sent without notifying anyone, and silent messages show Discord's bell badge and tooltip.
- Added a Font size setting in Appearance › Messages, from 12 to 24 pt. It resizes messages without changing the rest of the interface.
- Rebuilt the forum post composer as a SakuraCord modal with emoji, mention, channel and @time autocomplete, the attachment tray, drafts per forum, and clear validation.
- Improved coloured mentions, which now stay readable on any background, such as a white role inside an embed in light mode, while keeping the role's colour recognisable.
- Changed the composer to keep a conversation's staged files and in-progress slash command when you switch away and come back.
- Changed file uploads to send the same request fields as Discord's desktop app on every path, including replies, forum posts and voice messages.

## Servers and channels

- Added Pin Channel to Top, with a Pinned Channels section at the top of the channel list, synced with Discord.
- Fixed relaunching opening a server on its landing channel, sometimes one you had hidden. Servers now reopen where you left them.
- Fixed a Server Hub channel appearing at the top of community servers, which Discord doesn't show.
- Changed Escape in a full-width thread to stay in the thread, mark it read and jump to the newest message, as Discord does.
- Fixed reacting in archived threads, which now reopens the thread first where you're allowed to.

## Appearance

- Changed your theme colour to be SakuraCord's real macOS accent, used exactly as macOS uses one. Light mode no longer darkens pink to plum, and text selection and focus rings use the system's colours.
- Changed labels on accent-coloured buttons, badges and avatars to follow the macOS rule: white, or black on very light accents. This fixes the Schedule button's black label.
- Refined the member list, with APP badges styled like server tags, verified-app checkmarks and softer section headers, and gave the trailing sidebar an inspector's glass.
- Reworked message search around floating glass controls, with one-line channel headers and a page number you can type.
- Redesigned game profiles in SakuraCord's style, with sharp banners, the full-window media viewer and store and rating cards.
- Improved the quick switcher's secondary text, which is now readable in light mode, and VoiceOver now reads its rows.

## Fixes and polish

- Fixed stuttering while scrolling the emoji autocomplete menu.
- Fixed covered content changing the cursor or opening its context menu while a modal is open.
- Fixed spoiler reveals and loading shimmers ignoring Disable all animations, and download cards still offering Show in Finder after the file was moved.
- Fixed Markdown tables losing empty trailing rows and mentions inside masked links becoming clickable pills.
- Changed pull request builds to share settings with the regular app.
- Improved the issue reporter, which now explains when an attachment is too large instead of saying the service is unavailable.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.7-Beta-8...v0.1.7-Beta-9](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.7-Beta-8...v0.1.7-Beta-9)
discordAnnouncement:
**Favorites, scheduled messages and @silent 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Discord's Favorites server, synced both ways, with categories, Suggested Channels, an Add to Favorites picker and Thread Settings
- Schedule messages from the + menu and manage them in Inbox › Scheduled
- Send @silent messages, pin channels to the top of a server, and set your message font size from 12 to 24 pt
- Your theme colour is now the real macOS accent, and coloured mentions stay readable on any background
- A rebuilt forum post composer with autocomplete and drafts, plus redesigned game profiles
- Servers reopen where you left them after a relaunch, and the stray Server Hub channel is gone
